Yes, when the request names the token: the gate reads its contract powers, first-seen liquidity and ticker copies from our collector. A token the collector has not seen is read straight from the chain, but then its liquidity is unknown. It finds powers under the common names only, and facts are not re-read on a schedule yet. Unknown always means REVIEW.
Version 0 handles 6-decimal stablecoins only, so no price feed is needed.
